caption: The drawing depicts a puppet-like figure with a red, humanoid face that has exaggerated features including large green eyes with black outlines, prominent black eyebrows, a wide nose, a mouth with dark lips and visible teeth, and two short, pointed horns on top of its head. The figure's face and head are rendered in shades of red and pink. The body is covered by a red robe with dark stripes, reaching down to its legs. The robe has an uneven, layered hem near the midsection, and the sleeves hang loosely with brown, gloved hands protruding from each sleeve. The figure has light brown feet, with the right foot angled outward and the left foot pointed downward. The background is a plain, light beige color without any additional objects or scenery. The initials "G.D. File" appear in the lower right corner of the drawing.
title: Old Nick, the Devil
